# CANDIDATE: VIX_PUT_FILTER_AVOID_LOSERS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that avoiding put entries when VIX is below 15 or falling can skip loser days like 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 while preserving winner days. The VIX character (level and slope) has been shown to be a discriminator for bearish setup quality in prior revalidations (e.g., V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE high-confidence tier).

## Mechanism

Add a filter that rejects BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries when VIX < 15 OR the 5-bar VIX slope is negative (falling VIX). The filter runs in the entry path after quality-lock but before final trigger, using the same VIX source as the existing VIX confirmation rule (real-time quote). If the filter blocks, no entry is taken for that setup on that bar.
